description: Lista Sistemelor de irigare din Republica Moldova is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Portal Moldova, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by dataset.gov.md. The dataset contains information on irrigation systems in the RM: name, water source, surface, current status, irrigated land surface, etc. Coverage: MD. The portal shows the English title as "List of irrigation systems in the Republic of Moldova" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include sisteme de irigare. The listing shows 1 download or service links in XLS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is License Not Specified. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-government-open-data-portal-moldova.
